products.note: Goes in before the iron (sheet had it 5th).
products.why: It's strongly alkaline (pH 10–12.5, caustic potash). Going in early, into plain water, means it never meets the acidic iron or GreenMaxx neat, and it's well spread before the ethephon goes in.
Acidic (pH about 2). Goes in once the kelp is spread through the tank, and starts bringing the pH back down.
Acidic (pH 2–3), like the iron. Its SDS lists strong bases as incompatible, so it goes in after the kelp is well diluted.
Goes in last, once the iron and GreenMaxx have brought the pH back down after the kelp, so the ethephon never sits in alkaline water. The label says don't use alkaline water.

ppe_note: Promote Plus 900 is corrosive, so mix in the full kit.
spray_rules: No irrigation for 24 h. Don’t water in
spray_more: Spraying PPE is from the Shadow Ultra and Promote Plus 900 labels: cotton overalls, elbow-length chemical-resistant gloves, goggles or a face shield. Promote Plus 900: don’t spray if rain is expected within 8 h, and don’t leave the mix standing in metal for more than 2 h. Shadow Ultra: no rain or irrigation within 1 h, and no entry without protective clothing until the spray has dried.

flags.t: Pro Kelp is caustic in an ethephon tank
flags.d: Pro Kelp is pH 10–12.5 (caustic potash). Promote Plus 900’s label says don’t use alkaline water, and the GreenMaxx SDS lists strong bases as incompatible. This page puts the kelp in early and the Promote Plus last, then checks the tank is under pH 4.5. Jar test per 1 L of mix, in page order: 700 mL water, 1 mL Companion, 3 mL Shadow Ultra, 67 mL Pro Kelp, 100 mL iron, 117 mL GreenMaxx, 12 mL Promote Plus. Look for sludge or flecks after 10 minutes.
flags.s: Pro Kelp SDS Nov 2025 · GreenMaxx SDS Dec 2024 · APVMA 69487 eLabel

flags.t: Shadow Ultra 1.0 L/ha on the couch
flags.d: The label has no approach row. Bentgrass greens are 1–2 L/ha, hybrid couch fairways 0.15–0.6 L/ha, common couch 0.8–1.6 L/ha. Where the approach couch is a hybrid, 1.0 is above its row. Label also notes cool conditions or low growth may cause discolouration.

flags.t: Grass Roots Iron: sheet 30 L/ha, label 10–20 L/ha
flags.d: At 20 L/ha this tank takes 50 L, not 75 L. GreenMaxx carries 6% Fe as well, so the tank puts on about 4–5 kg Fe/ha in total.
flags.s: Oasis Turf label · GreenMaxx SDS Dec 2024

flags.t: Water volume is under two labels
flags.d: 300 L/ha is under Pro Kelp’s label volume (700 L/ha) and Shadow Ultra’s golf course range (350–500 L/ha).
GreenMaxx at 35 L/ha is about 9 kg N/ha (SG 1.31, 20% w/w) as stabilised urea, plus 1% Mg. Label range 20–50 L/ha. If its 20% is w/v, it’s 7 kg N/ha.
Pro Kelp moves up from 5th to 3rd, Promote Plus 900 moves from 3rd to last. Everything else keeps its place.

post_checks: Irrigation off on approaches and surrounds for 24 h
Mowers told: no mowing until it's dry
